# Multi-Factor Screener

> Every company in the S&P 500 scored on eight categories - valuation, quality, growth, momentum, risk, analyst revisions, size and investment - each against its own sector, ranked, with the arithmetic behind every number on the page. A research and teaching tool for students and investment clubs. It is not investment advice, and it does not tell anyone to buy or sell.

The ranking is rebuilt from the latest market close on weekday mornings. The dashboard draws its rankings in the browser from a data file, so a reader that does not run JavaScript gets the page's frame and none of the stocks: the methodology and the data file below are the readable versions.

## Pages

- [Rankings dashboard](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/): the ranked S&P 500, each stock's category scores, the inputs behind each score, and the caveats that go with them.
- [Factor Lab](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/lab.html): the published studies the screener's categories rest on, rerun on public data, with how far each rerun lands from its paper.
- [Does the ranking predict returns?](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/research.html): the screener's weighting and pre-registered alternatives tested on 2012-2026 S&P 500 history rebuilt from the filings published at the time.

## Methodology

- [How the screener works](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/SCREENER_OVERVIEW.md): every category, metric, weight and limitation, regenerated with each run.
- [Methodology changelog](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/METHODOLOGY_CHANGELOG.md): every change to how stocks are scored, with the evidence for it and the date.
- [README](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/README.md): what the project is and how it is built.

## Data

- [dashboard_data.js](https://calebsmit.github.io/screener-dashboard/dashboard_data.js): the published ranking as one JavaScript assignment, `window.SCREENER_DATA = {...}` (several megabytes). `kpis.run_timestamp` says which run it is; `table_data` holds every ranked stock with its rank, composite and category scores.

## Optional

- [Research notes](https://github.com/CalebSmit/screener-dashboard/tree/main/research): the dated notes behind each methodology decision, with citations.
- [Source code](https://github.com/CalebSmit/screener-dashboard): the scoring engine, the dashboard generator and their tests.
